# Third-party images that CI pulls, mirrored to ghcr.io/openctemio/mirror/
# by .github/workflows/ci-image-mirror.yml.
#
# Why: shared GitHub runner IPs exhaust the anonymous pull quotas of
# public.ecr.aws ("toomanyrequests: Data limit exceeded") and Docker Hub, and a
# job then fails before it runs anything. Pulls from GHCR with the job's
# GITHUB_TOKEN are not subject to those quotas. The mirror packages are public,
# so fork pull requests and the other openctemio repositories pull them too.
#
# Format: one image per line, `<source>@sha256:<digest> <mirror name>:<tag>`.
# The source is pinned by digest, and the copy keeps the manifest bytes, so
# ghcr.io/openctemio/mirror/<name>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> is the exact upstream
# image. A `docker.io/library/` source falls back to public.ecr.aws/docker/library/
# (same digests) when Docker Hub refuses.
#
# To bump an image: `crane digest <source>:<tag>`, update the digest here (and
# in any workflow or Dockerfile that pins it), and merge; the push to develop
# runs the mirror. The weekly run re-copies anything missing and prints a
# notice when an upstream tag has moved on from the pinned digest.

# CI service containers (api-ci, allinone-ci, docker-publish, web e2e stack;
# postgres:16-alpine and postgres:18-alpine: the PostgreSQL 16 and 18 jobs of api-ci and
# api-pg-compat, digests also there).
docker.io/library/postgres:16-alpine@sha256:f4610795587492cd4fb887c2dc3de301b813278bb6f616992061141b5f15ac36 postgres:16-alpine
docker.io/library/postgres:17-alpine@sha256:b0f9560a2de083e2cc7382e75f808c7381a32852a7ec49117deedb300e552b24 postgres:17-alpine
docker.io/library/postgres:18-alpine@sha256:77f585114c32fbca283dc835b0596f4e52b51b4c6662d7810b2f4084f60a1873 postgres:18-alpine
docker.io/library/redis:7-alpine@sha256:858f009f9709ce576febc734aa78b8f6d624b82571f9ddb6bda4377c833b3499 redis:7-alpine

# Job containers.
docker.io/semgrep/semgrep:1.178.0@sha256:32e459968daabe7ab86968184a29109b9564aa00392401156f9788452b42786b semgrep:1.178.0

# Digest-pinned base images of openctemio/sensor and openctemio/asset-collector
# (their CI and release builds swap them for these copies, same digest) and the
# sdk-go sandbox test container. Every other digest-pinned base of the sensor's
# Dockerfiles on main is mirrored daily as <name>:sha256-<hex>
# (ci-image-mirror.yml, .github/scripts/ci-image-bases.sh); asset-collector is
# private, so its bases are listed here: add a bumped digest here too.

docker.io/library/golang:1.26.9-alpine@sha256:3082400e369fa24d5fc60bca20edab3f6d604e0c5a690ec66b295eff4dd87ade golang:1.26.9-alpine
docker.io/library/golang:1.26.10-alpine@sha256:9ce231b28998b32e116927c61aa5c406183061d4f3f2d61b292c88e7f6bdf7ca golang:1.26.10-alpine
